title: Introduction to Web Design: Main Exam, 21 August 2025
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO

parts.text: Define the following technologies in the field of web development
HTML
HTTP
FTP
Browser
Identify any four elements used in writing HTML.
Create a simple web page that displays a table of students' records (name, mathematics, English, Kiswahili and science marks). The marks of the students should be bold and centred.
Create a simple web page that displays a list of items on sale (coffee, milk and bread), each item with a short description beneath it, as shown in the original paper.
Create a colour table with the cells RED, BLUE, GREEN and a merged RED+BLUE cell, using appropriate HTML code, as shown in the original paper.
Using a suitable example, explain the difference between CSS and HTML.
Write HTML code that would display a list of drinks (Coffee, Tea, Milk) with Tea having the nested items Black tea and Green tea.
Outline with clear examples HTML tags that can be used to display the following items on a web page.
Image
Link
Heading of a page
Paragraph
Give the HTML elements for creating the following content.
An image (logo.jpg) used as a link to an external website (www.mku.ac.ke)
A thin black horizontal line that runs half the width of the display
Merge two data cells within the same row
Give a row in the table the same background colour
Fix the width of a column in a table to 200 pixels
Make the table fill the entire display of the computer
Write short notes on the following.
Web designing vs web development
Server-side vs client-side scripting
Front-end vs back-end designing
HTML vs XML
Using examples, explain the following in relation to CSS.
The class selector
The id selector
Explain the functions of any four members of the ISO-OSI suite.
A form is an object in the document object model. Discuss at least four elements (objects) under the form object and the possible use of each object during web development.
As the project manager you are required to develop a website. Explain the process that this website project would entail from inception to completion.
State five types of tags used in HTML.
When talking about responsive web design, what are the differences between the mobile-first and the desktop-first approaches? Where does each excel and what are some of the issues it leads to?
